subject: Nimbus POC: onboarding checklist and gating plan
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Ellie Park <ellie.park@nimbus.ai>, Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@nimbus.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Nimbus POC: onboarding checklist and gating plan

Thanks again for the call this morning — great to meet the Nimbus team. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth for the trial: 

Objective / success criteria (as discussed)
- Ingest 150k tokens/day of customer queries into a sandbox connector and measure latency/throughput under a 99th percentile SLA of <500ms for inference.
- Evaluate hallucination/regression on a 150-sample prompt set (we will run our eval harness and share results).
- Confirm embedding similarity baseline for semantic search (target: avg cosine > 0.78 on your benchmark).

Trial scope and resources
- Sandbox environment: Redwood-hosted staging cluster (isolated project)
- Owners: Nimbus test lead (Ellie) + Redwood SE (Ben) + Jordan for program coordination

Access and security items we need to complete before we begin
1) SSO: we need your Okta metadata (idp-entity-id + x.509 cert) or the email domains you want to be auto-provisioned.
2) API keys: we will issue a time-limited staging API key scoped to the Nimbus project. Please confirm whether you need single-key or per-user keys for testing.
3) IP allowlist: please provide the CIDR(s) that should have access to the staging API endpoints (if any).
4) Procurement: procurement@ will need the quote and a standard PO/contract review — Jordan will attach the trial quote once procurement signal is received.

Proposed timeline
- Week 0 (this week): confirm SSO domain + IP allowlist, sign trial terms (simple form).
- Week 1: Redwood provisions staging project + API key, Okta app configured, and SE kickoff with your test lead.
- Week 2–3: run evaluation plan, share interim results, iterate on prompts/config.

Attachments: attached a short success-metrics workbook and our trial setup guide.

Next steps (action owners)
- Ellie: share Okta metadata and preferred IP ranges by EOD Friday.
- Tom: loop in procurement with PO cadence and redline concerns.
- Ben: provisioning + send temporary staging API key once we have SSO/IP info.

If you want, we can schedule a 30-minute provisioning call with your infra and Okta admin to walk through the steps.

Best,

Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: NIM-POC-success-metrics.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood-trial-setup-guide.pdf (guide)
From: Ellie Park <ellie.park@nimbus.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@nimbus.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Nimbus POC: onboarding checklist and gating plan

Thanks Jordan — that format is perfect. A few clarifications from our side: 

- SSO: yes, we use Okta. I'll pull the metadata (idp SSO URL and cert) and send it over. We prefer SAML app integration rather than SCIM for this trial.
- API keys: security wants short-lived keys (7-day rotation) scoped to the staging project. Per-user keys are preferred long-term, but for the POC a single scoped key is fine if it's rotated.
- IP allowlist: our staging CIDR is 34.82.128.0/24 and 34.82.129.0/24. Can you confirm Redwood accepts those?
- Procurement: Tom will drive the PO. He asked whether the trial quote requires a signature or if a simple acceptance email is sufficient.

Also, two questions for Ben / Jordan:
1) Can you confirm how prompt-level KV caching is handled — will the staging cluster persist session KV across restarts?
2) Do you provide example Helm/terraform snippets for customers that want to run the private deployment later?

I'll aim to get the Okta metadata to you by EOD Thursday.

Best,
Ellie Park
Lead Solutions Architect | Nimbus Analytics
ellie.park@nimbus.ai
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Ellie Park <ellie.park@nimbus.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Nimbus POC: onboarding checklist and gating plan

Appreciate the quick reply, Ellie — that's all workable. Responses inline: 

- IP allowlist: Redwood accepts the CIDRs you listed; Ben will add them to the staging security group and confirm the endpoints.
- API keys: we'll provision a time-limited staging key with a 7-day TTL and rotation notes. For the POC we'll give you a single scoped key; we can switch to per-user keys for pilot.
- KV caching: the staging runtime preserves KV cache for the session token lifespan; restarts clear ephemeral runtime cache but we persist prefix caches when configured. I'll have Ben paste the short doc excerpt in the thread.
- Private deployment snippets: yes, we have Helm charts and a minimal terraform module — see the 'redwood-trial-setup-guide.pdf' attachment and the Drive link I shared.

Ben — can you provision the staging project (nimbus-eval-2026) and add the IP ranges Ellie listed? Once provisioned please drop a one-time staging API key here (we'll mark it as temporary). Also, please attach the cache persistence note for Ellie.

Tom — for procurement: a simple acceptance email is fine for the trial credit. If Nimbus prefers a PO we can accommodate that as well; Jordan will send the quote PDF on request.

Thanks,
Jordan

Cache persistence note: the runtime persists prefix caches to an internal ephemeral store between healthy restarts; full KV snapshot persistence is part of Dedicated product, not included in hosted trial. For the POC we can enable prefix persistence (see excerpt below):
- Prefix persistence: stores prefix KV to temporary object store per-requester; survives process restarts but not cluster reprovision.
